query: What is the company pto policy
final_answer:
Employees receive 20 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with accrual beginning on their first day of employment [temp_2]. A reason for requesting PTO does not need to be specified [temp_1].

Regarding unused PTO:
*   The document indicates a policy on transferring remaining PTO to the next year, though the specific allowance is not fully stated in the provided text [temp_1].
*   If an employee leaves the company, accrued PTO may be compensated with their final paycheck, either according to local law or, if no legal provisions exist, to employees not terminated for cause [temp_1].

For exempt employees who work on a company-observed holiday, an additional day of PTO will be granted, which must be taken within 12 months after that holiday [temp_3].
